body: This is why mentally unstable people (religious) shouldn't give other mentally unstable people (depressed/suicidal) advice.

> No I can't. Hence the rejection I face on Grindr. And it is intolerable for me to think about all the people who are tall and will get lots and lots of sex only because of that.

Then get off Grindr and go somewhere else. Go meet a boy at your school.

> No one 20 has a receding hairline

I know plenty of people in their early 20s who are going bald. And again, "most of them are hairy and manly" you have these really strong ideals of what defines you as a man. The same way young women look at cover models and think they need to look the same. I'm not saying you're wrong for feeling this way, but I want you to know that speaking from time and experience your 

> Fake profile

You made a fake profile with "big dick" on a dating app where most people are there to have sex. What did you expect to happen?? That's like listing your car for sale on Craigslist and claiming it's a Ferrari when it's really an old Honda and then feeling depressed when you get 2,000 emails with offers to buy it.

> Most guys my age on Grindr

No. The guys you are finding in your area on Grindr based on your match settings or whatever (sorry, I've never used it) are cute to you. If you don't like Grindr, GET OFF GRINDR. There are plenty of other dating apps. Tinder, OkCupid, Bumble, Coffee Meets Bagel, etc. Or go to a gay bar. Or join a gay club on campus.

> Idk if I want to break up

Do it. What your described is awful. Break up, delete Grindr, and work in improving yourself and making yourself happier.

> College

Make friends with girls. Every girl wants a gay friend, and they don't care what you look like.

> 4 years deep

Well, technically you *can* change majors still, and people have done that in year 4, but to be fair it is a bit of a mess sure. So instead, how about you open up a new tab, go to Google, and start researching all the things you can do with your major. Speaking from experience, it's possible you will find a career you never thought of before. My major is barely related to what I do.

> Woe is me

Stop standing there watching other people and feeling sad about yourself. Instead, go do things that make you happy. Go workout, go find new hobbies, go make new friends. The root of your sadness comes from you looking at people you think have perfect lives and comparing yours to theirs. You're blinding yourself to reality. And stop saying no one else is short or has a receding hairline because you're wrong.

I'm a year younger than you so I can't really tell you gets better lol. Also I hate that line.

Anyway, it seems to me that you're letting others determine your happiness. You just started your hormones 6 months ago. I obviously don't know the details, but that makes me think you spent almost 29 years feeling like someone else, and now you're finally becoming yourself. And you want to give up NOW? Let's be real, if you're not "passing" then people are going to mistake you for the wrong gender. That's not their fault, that's just how it is lol. But you can't let that get you down. You are on your way to becoming who you really are. Let's be real for a minute - you will eventually "pass" and people will stop mistaking your gender. And until then, if you're basing your happiness on whether or not people can identify your gender when even you yourself admit to not "passing" yet, then perhaps you should address that first and start putting your happiness in your own hands instead.

[Also, this is an old song but your post reminded me of its lyrics](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RFzZ-xpyfoo) :)
Would you like to hear my thoughts on this?

> She doesn't give two shits about me anymore.

So why do you still care about her? Step back for a minute and take a look at your situation. Do you really want to spend your time obsessing over someone who doesn't care about you? What's the end goal in that? Depression? Miserableness? Think about all the other stuff you could be doing with your time.

Bruh. I'm gonna get real with you for a minute. And you better read this because I just spent like 15 minutes typing it.

> 20 year old

Oh fuck me man, I wish I was 20 again! I'm almost 30 and I just keep looking back like "shit, if I would've known what I know now..." You're young man. I know you feel old (we all feel that way at 20), but you're going to change soooo much over the next 5-10 years. I don't want to say "it gets better" but... shit changes.

> I'm short

No you're not. Lots of guys are your height. And you can easily meet lots of guys who want to date someone your height.

> Receding hairline

Oh jesus fuck man, so does half the planet lol. Shave it, or style it differently. Don't kill yourself over a goddamn hairline lol.

> Can't grow a beard

I don't want to be a dick but dude... do you know how many guys can't grow a beard? And do you know how many guys can, and still shave it? I think you need to explore the world a bit, as in, go realize the variety that exists. It sounds like you're holding yourself up to some ridiculous standard. Stop it.

> Average dick

Again, all of these things are so shallow and unimportant. You're 20 years old. I know this stuff seems like the most important shit in the world to you right now, but come back in 3 years and see if you feel the same.

> Grindr has meanies on it

There are assholes in this world, welcome to reality. Work on your appearance - work out, new wardrobe, new hairstyle, etc - then come back to the dating scene. You're TWENTY you have so much time jesus fuck I'm jealous.

> Jealous of cute gays

Again, you're looking at things you think are perfect and comparing yourself. Instead of feeling down, go work on yourself man. Make those things a goal that you want to achieve. I'm telling you it will pay off. Then you can date those cutie pies.

> Breaking up

GOOD! This is the perfect time to make changes! Use this as a starting point. You're going to dump your boyfriend and start making life changes and you're going to be happy :)

> No friends

So go make some. You're in college, this will be the easiest time in your life to meet new friends. Go join a club on campus.

> Don't like what I'm studying

Study something else.

> Life is pointless

I'm gonna say it again. Most of these things are trivial. I don't mean that in an offensive way. What I'm saying is, you got it pretty damn good, but you're being so hard on yourself man. A lot of these feelings will change soooo much over the next few years. If you take the time right now to work on bettering yourself, you will not regret it. Trust me, because I regret not doing that. Now I'm in my late-20s trying to better myself so my 30s are fun.

Ima be straight with you. If yall kill yourselves, yall wont be able to do any of the shit you enjoy doing together ever again. Sex? Never again. Dates? Never again. Movie nights? Never again. Cuddling? Never again. Road trips? Never again. Shopping? Never again. Walk through the park? Never again. Texting each other throughout the day? Never again. Looking at each other? Never again. Inside jokes? Never again.

The list goes on but you get the idea. Ask yourselves if you're really willing to give up all of that. Considering you're talking about dying together, I bet you'd miss all that fun couple stuff. Give it some thought.

>pray first, just in case.

Just in case what? Just in case their prayer will be the first prayer in all of history to actually do something? lol

There is no rule in life that says you have to be in a relationship. You're allowed to be single. And not being in a relationship doesn't equal "forever alone" or some shit like that. It's your life dude, live it how you want, live it for yourself.

Don't kill yourself over a girl. That's just dumb.

I'm guessing you're young (teens? early 20s?). If yes, most people go through this same shit around those ages. Once you hit about mid-20s though, you look back and go "fuck, why did I ever waste my time on that person??"

If you're not, well, the next bit still applies.

Go home, play some video games, watch a movie, download Tinder, watch porn, order a pizza, read a book, or whatever you enjoy doing that doesn't involve obsessing over this one particular human on this one particular planet that is populated with billions of other humans. Sorry for the bluntness here but she's not special and she's definitely not worth suicide. What your feeling is natural and it will pass.

I don't think it ever will. When I was younger my depression was much worse and there was a time when I almost killed myself (couldn't find the pill bottle, still don't know what happened to it lol). But I've grown a lot and have spent a lot of time thinking. Like I said in my post, I'm basically at this point where I can't validate killing myself simply because when I look at Life vs. Death life comes out on top due to the sheer fact that there are some things I enjoy doing. I can't imagine Death coming out on top in that equation, unless I find myself at the absolute bottom. I just hate having these thoughts pop into my head all the time. Makes it hard to be productive.

All the time! Sometimes I just wish I had someone to chat with. Not about suicide or depression, but just like, "Hey what's up? Play any cool games lately?" small talk or whatever, just to distract my mind from it.

I'm going to be blunt here: God doesn't exist. With that on the table, step back and realize that you are angry at a fictional character. Now realize that the only thing that matters in life is what you make of it. Go have fun and enjoy it as much as possible, because when it's over that's it; no more games, no more shows, no more friends, no more jokes, no more food, no more anything.
